bullets.text: Built and shipped a production data pipeline integrating three insurance platforms, replacing manual policy re-entry for a live agency.
Designed an append-only raw event log plus a separate committed audit log, making every webhook payload replayable after a crash without duplicating rows.
Deployed as three Docker containers with restart policies and automatic recovery from host reboot, running unattended on an ARM single-board server.
Wrote an idempotent record merge that reconciles sparse duplicate events without overwriting richer values from earlier events.
Integrated a third-party CRM API including authentication, employee resolution, and multi-location account handling.

blocks.title: Auto Interner — truthful resume tailoring pipeline

bullets.text: Built a 22k-line modular Python pipeline that screens job listings and generates tailored DOCX resumes, with 32 test modules and offline fakes at every external boundary.

Designed a deterministic truthfulness validator that rejects any generated rewrite which alters a numeric claim, introduces a technology absent from the source, or escalates a stated proficiency level.
Enforced a hard PII boundary: contact data is extracted into a local-only block and never included in any model request.
Wrote a provider-neutral model adapter with strict tool-response schemas re-validated locally, so the vendor can change without touching policy code.
Packaged as a multi-architecture Docker image with crash-aware state reconciliation and non-overlapping run coordination.
Built a 10k-line Flutter game shipping to Android and web, with automated gameplay, persistence, security, and accessibility test suites.
Implemented authenticated local saves with rollback and replay protection so an interrupted session cannot be exploited to recover a lost wager.
Added screen-reader labels and larger-text layouts across the wager and charm menus.
